title: Vendor Archive - Ops, Data Quality, Compliance
description: ClickHouse-backed operational, data quality, and compliance visibility for the vendor archive pipeline.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY environment

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY vendor_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS events FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor'

SELECT quantile(0.95)(greatest(0, dateDiff('second', created_at, ingested_at))) AS p95_lag_seconds FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor'

SELECT count() AS duplicate_request_ids FROM (SELECT request_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY request_id HAVING count() > 1)
SELECT countIf(payload_truncated = 1) AS truncated_payloads FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor'

SELECT countIf(s3_request_key = '' OR s3_response_key = '') AS rows_missing_s3_keys FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor'

SELECT countIf(match(request_payload, '[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]') OR match(response_payload, '[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]') OR match(request_payload, '[6-9][0-9]{9}') OR match(response_payload, '[6-9][0-9]{9}')) AS possible_pii_rows FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor'

SELECT toStartOfMinute(ingested_at) AS time, environment, count() AS rows FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY time, environment ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, quantile(0.95)(greatest(0, dateDiff('second', created_at, ingested_at))) AS p95_lag_seconds FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, status, count() AS calls FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

SELECT vendor_id, count() AS rows, countIf(user_id = '') AS missing_user_id, countIf(loan_application_number IS NULL) AS missing_lan, countIf(request_hash = '') AS missing_request_hash, countIf(s3_request_key = '' OR s3_response_key = '') AS missing_s3_key, countIf(pan_masked = '') AS missing_pan_mask, countIf(mobile_hash = '') AS missing_mobile_hash, countIf(aadhaar_last4_hash = '') AS missing_aadhaar_hash FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY vendor_id ORDER BY rows DESC

SELECT vendor_id, endpoint, count() AS calls, round(avg(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_ms, quantile(0.50)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99_ms, max(latency_ms) AS max_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY vendor_id, endpoint HAVING calls >= 3 ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT request_id, any(vendor_id) AS vendor_id, any(endpoint) AS endpoint, min(created_at) AS first_seen, max(ingested_at) AS last_ingested, count() AS copies FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' GROUP BY request_id HAVING copies > 1 ORDER BY copies DESC, last_ingested DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT created_at, vendor_id, endpoint, request_id, pan_masked, mobile_last4, payload_truncated, length(request_payload) AS request_payload_bytes, length(response_payload) AS response_payload_bytes FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND environment LIKE '$environment' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND (match(request_payload, '[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]') OR match(response_payload, '[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]') OR match(request_payload, '[6-9][0-9]{9}') OR match(response_payload, '[6-9][0-9]{9}') OR payload_truncated = 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
